attchmntText: Equippp Social Impact Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: EQUIPPP Social Impact Technologies Limited has published its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The publication was released in the Financial Express All India Edition in English and Mana Telangana Hyderabad Edition in Telugu. The company submitted this information to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The extracts are also available on the company website www.equippp.in. The announcement was signed by Ms. Pooja Sharma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on 15th November 2026.

attchmntText: Equippp Social Impact Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: EQUIPPP Social Impact Technologies Limited approved an inter-corporate loan of up to Rs. 2,00,00,000 to RI Networks Private Limited and authorized the incorporation of a Limited Liability Partnership with Dr. Bhaskar Chatterjee for AI-based CSR monitoring solutions. The Board re-appointed Dr. Narendra Mairpady as Chairperson with immediate effect. The company noted the successful listing of Grace Cancer Foundation’s project on the NSE Social Stock Exchange, raising Rs. 1 crore. Unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, were reviewed. Net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 735. Trade receivables of Rs. 111.10 Lakhs as on September 30, 2026, are overdue. The Board meeting concluded at 03:50 PM IST on November 13, 2026.
